Brows.name: Eyebrow Wax
Brows.summary: Clean, tidy, and define your natural brow shape with gentle, skin-friendly hot waxing and a soothing botanical finish.

Brows.name: Eyebrow Tint
Brows.summary: Custom-blended tint formulated to enrich brow depth, fill lighter hairs, and enhance natural arch fullness.

Brows.name: Signature Brows
Brows.summary: Signature brows - combines precision mapping, tinting, and waxing to shape the brow to suit your facial structure.

Brows.name: Brow Lamination
Brows.summary: A semi-permanent treatment that smooths, lifts, and sets unruly or sparse brow hairs into a fuller, fluffy brow shape. Results last 4-6 weeks. Includes a custom tint and brow wax.

Brows.name: Hybrid Brows
Brows.summary: Upgrades traditional tinting to a long-lasting hybrid stain for a richer, bolder, makeup-like finish combined with custom mapping and precision wax.

Eyes.name: Eyelash Tint
Eyes.summary: Deep, glossy lash enhancement that creates the appearance of longer, naturally darker lashes from root to tip without mascara.

Eyes.name: Lash Lift & Tint
Eyes.summary: Lifts and curls natural lashes from the root while adding a glossy tint for an open, wide-awake gaze that lasts 6-8 weeks.

Eyes.name: Korean Lash Lift & Tint
Eyes.summary: A Korean lash lift is a modern, gentle treatment that curls, lifts and nourishes your natural lashes from the root - no extensions or harsh perming chemicals. The result is a more noticeable, wide-eyed effect, finished with a tint for added depth.

Lips.name: Lip Wax
Lips.summary: Quick, delicate hair removal along the upper lip line for smooth, clear skin using soothing, sensitive hot wax.

Lips.name: Chin Wax
Lips.summary: Smooth, precise hair removal along the chin line using gentle, sensitive hot wax with botanical post-wax care.

Combos.name: Signature Brows, Lash Lift & Tint

Combos.summary: Combines precision brow mapping, tinting, and waxing to shape the brow to suit your facial structure, together with a lash lift & tint
